dispositions.topic_text: Required TRN-001 transport-guard test cases and assertions
dispositions.what: TRN-001: an untrusted Host and a wildcard-free trusted host, a body at and one byte over max_request_body_bytes, each refused case never reaching a handler

dispositions.topic_text: Required TRN-002 origin and viewer-cookie test cases and assertions
dispositions.what: TRN-002: viewer sign-out from the canonical origin succeeds and from another scheme, host or effective port is refused; a viewer project read without the cookie is refused
TRN-003: requests carrying Authorization, the viewer cookie and secret-like fields, on success and refusal, leave no such value in any log line

dispositions.reason: The witness is the Workbench gate: design_lint --state 2 reads the security review section of A31 against SECURITY_REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md and refuses a category without an outcome, an APPLICABLE one without an accepted decision, an UNRESOLVED one without an open question and a NOT_APPLICABLE one without rationale.

dispositions.topic_text: Timing and ordering of request-body and binary-response bound checks
dispositions.what: A14/A25: the emitted binary_storage stops reading at the read bound (it never reads a whole oversize object), and the body bound refuses before the handler
